description: This file defines a Java interface named SerialPortEventListener which declares a single method serialEvent for handling serial port events in the jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector) library.

classes.name: SerialPortEventListener
classes.description: An interface for receiving serial port events, requiring implementing classes to define the serialEvent method.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: A callback method invoked when a serial port event occurs, passing a SerialPortEvent object.
